title: Enable urlContext, web search and code execution tools on google vertex
body:
### Description

These tools are available on `@ai-sdk/google` but not `@ai-sdk/google-vertex`

### AI SDK Version

```
"ai": "5.0.2",
"@ai-sdk/google-vertex": "3.0.2",
```

linked_prs.title: feat(provider/google-vertex): add support for urlContext, googleSearch and codeExecution tools
linked_prs.body:
## background

google vertex  provider was missing the urlContext, web search and code execution tools that are available in the @ai-sdk/google provider, forcing users to import from @ai-sdk/google/internal as a workaround

## summary

- add tools property to GoogleVertexProvider interface and implementation
- expose googleSearch, urlContext and codeExecution tools on vertex provider instance

## verification

- all tests pass including new tools exposure test
- code execution example works with vertex.tools.codeExecution()  
- examples updated to use vertex.tools instead of external imports

## tasks

- [x] google-vertex-tools.ts module created to re-export tools from @ai-sdk/google
- [x] tools property added to GoogleVertexProvider interface
- [x] provider.tools exposed in factory function
- [x] tools exported from main index.ts
- [x] tests for tools property
- [x] examples updated to use vertex.tools syntax
- [x] documentation updated with tool sections and model support info

related issue - closes #7753

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.  
The issue concerns missing tool support (urlContext, web search, code execution) in the agent system's integration with the Google Vertex LLM provider, which falls under "Tool-related issues" and "Incompatibility with LLM providers" in the agent issue taxonomy.
